source_documents.title: Manipulating H ‐aggregation of Cyanine Dimers by Side‐chain Engineering for High‐contrast Tumor Surgical Navigation

reference_evidence_units.quote: Notably, DCyPr displayed more pronounced H-shoulder peaks, indicative of stronger H-aggregate formation (Figure 1b).
reference_evidence_units.subject: DCy-Pr vs Cy-Azo
reference_evidence_units.statement: The dimer shows a stronger blue-shifted H band than the monomer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This stark contrast indicated that dimerization led to enhanced fluorescence quenching of cyanine dyes.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DCy-Pr vs Cy-Azo

reference_evidence_units.quote: In addition, fluorescence quantum yield (Φf ) analysis revealed that Cy-Azo had a Φf of 0.06% using ICG as a reference (Φf = 2.4% in water).
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cy-Azo
reference_evidence_units.statement: The monomer probe is also weakly emissive.

reference_evidence_units.quote: As shown in Figure 2g, the addition of GSH to DCy-Pr led to a marked decrease in its H-aggregate shoulder peak and a concomitant increase in the monomeric absorption
reference_evidence_units.subject: DCy-Pr + GSH
reference_evidence_units.statement: Disassembly of the H-aggregate on reaction restores the monomer band and emission (151-fold).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Reaction also changes the molecule (GSH substitution).

reference_evidence_units.quote: Notably, DCy-Pr and DCy-SO3 displayed higher shoulder peaks compared to monomeric peaks, indicative of strong H-aggregation, whereas DCy-PEG3 and DCy-Am exhibited more pronounced monomeric peaks (Figure S3).
reference_evidence_units.subject: DCy-Pr vs DCy-PEG3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Hydrophobic propyl chains give strong H-aggregation; PEG chains do not.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The measured Φf values for DCy-PEG3 , DCy-SO3 , and DCy-Am were 9.90%, 2.73%, and 19.16%, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DCy-PEG3

reference_evidence_units.quote: In contrast, DCy-PEG3 and DCy-Am showed a much smaller increase of only about 7-fold (Figure S4).
reference_evidence_units.subject: DCy-PEG3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Little emission gain on dissolving in DMSO: little aggregation quenching in water.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results indicated that DCy-Pr and DCy-SO3 had a stronger tendency to aggregate in aqueous solution, leading to more pronounced fluorescence quenching.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DCy-Pr
reference_evidence_units.statement: Aggregation in water causes the quenching.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Weakly emissive in water (Φf 0.06%) with a smaller H shoulder than the dimer; the paper treats it as less aggregated.

out_of_pool: PROBE_REACTION: GSH attacks the meso aryl ether (SNAr) and releases the cyanine; the turn-on after reaction concerns the product

contrast_group.varied_factor: dimerization (DCy-Pr vs monomer Cy-Azo) and side chain (propyl vs PEG3), relative to DCy-Pr
contrast_group.paper_difference: DCy-Pr forms strong H-aggregates and is non-emissive; the monomer aggregates less; the PEG3 dimer stays monomer-like and bright (Φf 9.9%).

structure_verification.note: Written as the cyanine cation(s); the counter-anion is not reported (IR-780 iodide was the precursor).
